thread_text:
rachel: FYI spotted weird NaNs in embeddings from quant-v4 models when runtime=3.6.4 + sdk=4.1.2. proposing a scoped runtime pin for the quant-v4 cohort during tonight's change window (01:00 UTC).

diego: can you share the minimal repro / logs?

rachel: log snippet:
```
2026-05-10T00:22:11Z WARN model-output: detected NaN in embedding vector
model: quant-v4-1.0
runtime: 3.6.4
sdk: 4.1.2
route: /v1/embeddings
```

pm-nora: customer-impact: a handful of Dedicated customers use quant-v4 for embeddings-heavy workloads in us-east; recommend scoped pin.

rachel: plan: deploybot pin add --id pb-4200 --runtime runtime:3.6.3 --scope "model-group:quant-v4" --duration 4h --meta "reason:kernel-abi-compat-4.1.2" at 2026-05-10T01:00:00Z. monitor nan-rate, embed-magnitude, p95 latency. rollback criteria: nan-rate >0.1% over 10m -> rollback to 3.6.4 or disable SDK 4.1.2 rollout.

deploybot: scheduled action pb-4200 by rachel for 2026-05-10T01:00:00Z.

deploybot: executed pb-4200 at 2026-05-10T01:00:05Z  pinned runtime:3.6.3 to scope:model-group:quant-v4 (pb-4200).

srebot: alert rule created: metric=quantv4-nan-rate > 0.05% over 5m -> page @oncall-eng-sre.

diego: initial telemetry shows nan-rate dropped to baseline. watching for perf regressions.

rachel: ops note: use `deploybot pin remove --id pb-4200` to remove, or `deploybot rollback --id pb-4200 --target runtime:3.6.4` to revert routing. prefer pin remove when SDK patch lands.

pm-nora: I'll prepare customer comms if we need extension beyond 4h.

rachel: update: after 3h stable with no pages, lifting pin at 05:00 UTC. deploybot pin remove --id pb-4200 executed.

srebot: pb-4200 lifecycle: created -> active -> removed. recorded no pager escalations.

diego: relnotes: "Temporary runtime pin (3.6.3) for quant-v4 embedding models to mitigate NaN regression observed during SDK 4.1.2 rollout; scoped and short-lived."

rachel: closing thread. will reopen if customers report regressions. :white_check_mark:
